messages:
Nina: flagging an uptick in leads lingering in 'intake_pending' for >25m this morning. Mostly webinar + ebook forms from APAC. SLA breach. Anyone else seeing a pattern?
Jared: yep noticed it. dashboard shows enrichment success rate dropped around 02:17-02:36 PT, and the round-robin dispatcher didn't move them to overflow.
Priya: looks like the HubSpot webhook retried but ultimately timed out. The workflow is still waiting on enrichment rather than firing the fallback route.
Sohail: quick idea: add an explicit 'enrich_timeout' webhook step in HS that marks property enrich_status=timed_out and triggers the claim queue after 20s. That reduces dependency on the enrichment callback.
Nina: agree. also we should tag timed_out leads with original_utm so SDRs know they missed enrichment. we had one where SF upsert removed critical fields and created an ownerless lead.
Jared: note for SF mapping: when enrich fields are missing, switch to mapping profile 'fallback_minimal' and set owner=apac_overflow_pool. currently mapping assumes full enrichment and fails on nulls.
Priya: can we make the round-robin consumer idempotent? Right now when enrichment later completes, it reassigns and sometimes steals back leads mid-conversation. Need a lock-window like 15m.
Sohail: adding a claim-lock TTL of 15m + a flag claim_reassign_allowed=false until SDR marks interest. That preserves initial fallback owner.
DeployBot: hubspot-workflow/timeout-hotpatch v0.1 deploying -> staging (id: dpl-9a7).
Nina: I'll create a lightweight test harness: synthetic webinar submit -> simulated enrichment delay 30s -> observe fallback branch, SF upsert, and round-robin lock.
Jared: added monitoring rule: alert if percent_in_timed_out_over_1h > 3% -> channel #marketing-ops. Also added a metric for reassign_conflicts per 24h.
Priya: created ticket MKTO-6721 with patch steps: HS timeout step, SF fallback mapping, claim-lock TTL, and a rollback plan.
Sohail: quick config snippet for HS webhook step: ```webhook: enrich_call; timeout: 20s; on_timeout: set enrich_status=timed_out; branch: fallback_claim_queue```
Nina: staging test passed: fallback branch triggered and SF mapping used fallback_minimal, owner assigned to apac_overflow_pool. round-robin respected claim_lock.
Jared: will schedule production run at 10:00 PT with 30m monitoring. Priya, can you be on the post-deploy check?
Priya: yes, I'll run sampling queries and verify no ownerless records and no surge in dup-claims.
Nina: thanks team. Long-term item: make enrichment service horizontally autoscale on queue depth and add a circuit-breaker so HS sees graceful errors instead of timeouts. Adding to roadmap. :rocket:
